initialPrompt:
Create a production-ready PAINTED CHARACTER WALK-CYCLE SPRITE SHEET by editing the first attached sailor. Use the second attached camp only as a style reference. Save the final PNG to /workspace/auckland-castaways/adventure/dist/assets/walk/player.png if supported.

Technical layout: exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels, TRANSPARENT background, exactly THREE equal columns and TWO equal rows, six 512 by 512 animation cells. No gridlines, no borders, no text, no numbers, no scenery, no shadows on the ground, no opaque backdrop. Every cell must contain the ENTIRE same sailor from hat to boot soles, fully contained with transparent padding. Cell centers x=256,768,1280 and y=256,768. In each cell sailor is about 440px tall, soles on local y=486, head top near local y=46, body/pelvis centered local x=256. Keep identical camera, identity, clothing, size, facing direction and registration. All six figures face RIGHT in clear side profile, as an actual continuous animation of walking to the right.

Preserve this particular sailor's blue-grey knitted cap, brown messy hair and short beard, mustard yellow tied neck scarf, worn teal-grey patched long coat, beige waistcoat, dark patched trousers rolled at ankles, and brown lace-up boots. Hand-painted 19th-century book illustration with subtle ink contours and watercolor/gouache texture to match attached character and camp. Hands empty, no props, no weapon.

Six DIFFERENT drawn poses in reading order, make leg articulation and counter-swinging arms unmistakeable. Frame1 top-left LEFT CONTACT: left foot extended forward rightwards heel down, right foot extended rearward leftwards toe down, right arm forward/left arm back. Frame2 top-middle LEFT DOWN: left planted leg supports weight with visibly bent knee, rear right heel lifts and right knee begins forward; right arm comes toward neutral. Frame3 top-right LEFT PASSING: left support foot under hips on ground, right thigh swinging forward with right knee bent and right boot raised off ground; arms pass sides. Frame4 bottom-left RIGHT CONTACT: right foot extended forward rightwards heel down, left foot extended backward leftwards toe down, LEFT arm forward and RIGHT arm back. Frame5 bottom-middle RIGHT DOWN: right planted support knee visibly bends, left foot lifting behind and swinging forward; arm counter swing distinct. Frame6 bottom-right RIGHT PASSING: right support foot under hips grounded, LEFT knee bent lifting forward with left boot off ground, arm swing reversed relative frame3. Show authentic alternating leg positions and alternating arms, front/back limbs have consistent subtle shading. Six real walking animation drawings, NEVER duplicate or merely translate a standing pose. Distinct moving knees and shoes are essential. Fixed same ground baseline in all cells and near-identical head height for stable game sprite playback. Full body in every cell.
